purpose: Canonical campaign-global graph connecting security requirements and properties to threats, manual review, automated testing, simulations, candidate/finding validation, remediation, and final assurance claims.
completenessRules: Every material PROP-* must have at least one accepted downstream evidence disposition before Phase 10.
Every material HYP-* must map to one or more PROP-* and must receive a validation disposition.
Every CAND-* must terminate in Phase 8 as VALIDATED_FINDING, DISMISSED, DUPLICATE, or UNRESOLVED_LIMITATION.
Every validated FIND-* must map to its affected PROP-* or HYP-* and to remediation/no-remediation disposition.
Every material final CLAIM-* must trace backward to accepted immutable evidence and exact source/release identity.
A missing edge is never silently inferred from narrative prose; add the edge or record an explicit typed traceability gap.
Every material change event must be classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX before affected evidence is reused.
Every INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND event must have an INV-* node and explicit edges to affected evidence/current replacements or open OBL-* work.
Phase 10 cannot rely on evidence with unresolved INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND state.

0: Initialize graph and add SOURCE-* campaign/source identity root.
1: Add SCOPE-* and material DEP-* nodes; connect them to SOURCE-* and frozen audit surface.
2: Add every material PROP-* from the Phase-2 registry and connect each to source/spec/scope basis.
3: Add every material HYP-* and connect each HYP-* to targeted PROP-* and applicable dependency/boundary nodes.
Add/update DOMAIN-* nodes from the deterministic Domain Applicability Registry and connect activated domains to relevant SCOPE-*/PROP-*/HYP-* nodes.
4: Add MAN-* coverage nodes and CAND-* nodes; connect reviewed properties/hypotheses and candidate origins.
Every TRIGGERED/UNCERTAIN_INCLUDE DOMAIN-* must connect to executed MAN-* specialist review evidence or an explicit blocking/typed limitation relationship.
5: Record economic/retrace confirmations, contradictions, new items and downstream execution relationships without rewriting prior nodes.
6: Add FUZZ-* campaign nodes; map each material fuzzable PROP-*/HYP-* to executed campaign or explicit terminal disposition.
Consume active DOMAIN-* decisions when mapping domain-specific PROP-*/HYP-* to fuzz campaigns and execution limitations.
7: Add SIM-* nodes; map lifecycle/integration simulations to PROP-*/HYP-*/CAND-* targets and results.
Consume active DOMAIN-* decisions when selecting lifecycle recipes/simulations; connect expressible domain simulations or typed limitations.
8: Terminate every CAND-* with validation disposition; add FIND-* nodes for validated findings and duplicate/dismissal relationships.
9: Add REM-* nodes or explicit no-remediation disposition; connect replacement evidence/regression tests to affected FIND-*/PROP-* nodes.
10: Add material CLAIM-* nodes and prove backward traceability to accepted evidence; close or explicitly limit every material traceability path.
